previous_selected10_independent_finding.defect: Both chunk loops are empty and no leaf record is emitted. This makes an observed empty byte string indistinguishable from an absent/unobserved capture in the saved evidence.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.change: Emit an explicit bytes leaf for zero length with total_bytes=0, the actual empty SHA-256 and an empty chunk list, preserving its location/type. Do not infer missing values as zero.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.qualification: Static empty-range evidence loss; no candidate page writer executed.
